title: Remove a Logo from an Image Online
description: Remove an unwanted logo from an image you own or are authorized to edit. Supports JPG, PNG, and WEBP.
heading: Remove distracting logos from your images
intro: Clean product shots, presentation assets, and personal images with a streamlined browser-based workflow.

process.heading: How to Remove a Logo from an Image
process.intro: Remove an unwanted logo from an authorized image in three simple browser-based steps.

steps.title: Upload Your Image
steps.description: Choose a JPG, PNG, or WEBP image up to 10 MB that you own or have permission to edit.

steps.title: Remove the Logo
steps.description: The tool processes the visible logo while working to preserve the surrounding colors and details.

steps.title: Review and Download
steps.description: Compare the before-and-after result, then download the cleaned image through a temporary link.

faq.heading: Questions About Removing Logos from Images
faq.intro: Find answers about supported images, privacy, and responsible logo removal.

items.question: What image formats are supported?
items.answer: You can upload JPG, PNG, and WEBP images up to 10 MB.

items.question: Are my images kept private?
items.answer: Files are stored in private object storage and scheduled for automatic deletion after 24 hours.

items.question: Can I remove any watermark?
items.answer: Only edit images you own or have permission to modify. Some protected or complex marks may require manual editing.
